title: An approved end-of-pipeline checkpoint commits
intent: Pin the other side of the commit gate: with an approving mechanism the git effect runs exactly once and the audit records the approval.

input.featureRequest: Accept a new optional config block and validate it.

request.message: bober(sprint-1): accept and validate the new config block

expected.notes: Exactly one git.commit call. The interpreter's approval check and the effect registry's declared-tag check are two independent locks on the same door; this case is green only when both were opened by a real approval.
